comment: The extension registry. An extension enters as `proposed` with a specification page under spec/extensions/; it becomes `experimental` with a reference implementation and conformance cases (a metadata-only extension substitutes a round-trip test in a reference for cases); it leaves experimental when two implementers sign off and a producer ships a package using it (CONTRIBUTING.md).

implementations: LocalGPT crates/world-physics — the origin, pre-extraction; flips to the crate
ext-physics.notes: Three implementations (JS, Rust, Python — the Rust one now the extracted crates.io crate), all running the same outcome assertions in their CI (npm test here; cargo test -p localgpt-world-physics in LocalGPT). The first package shipped using the extension is examples/the-drop-test. Still experimental until a producer outside this repository ships one. Semantic outcomes are the contract — bit-exact cross-engine trajectories are never promised.

ext-strict-determinism.notes: Ensures bit-exact simulation reproducibility across engines using fixed-point math and pinned floating-point rules.

ext-visibility.notes: Allows authors to conditionally hide entities (e.g. traps, GM secrets) from specific profiles until revealed.

ext-cinematography.notes: Cameras as entities with a filmback and a lens; shots as ordered setups on the clock; 0.3 adds aim_entity and focus_entity — a camera that aims and focuses on an actor by entity reference, marked x-entity-ref in the extension's schema so the one generated list carries them and every reference binds, rewrites and validates them like parent. Four implementations, all running the same outcome assertions — derived FOV, frame membership, centring and focus by entity through parents, the shot list — in their own CI; the JS renderer looks through a shot letterboxed to its frame (world.html?shot=). Version 0.1 promised splines and keyframed tracks and implemented nothing; 0.2 scoped to cameras and shots — tracks return as ext-cinematography.track when a producer needs animatics. Still experimental until a producer outside this repository ships a package using it.

ext-provenance.notes: Carries LLM lineage metadata such as prompt, model, and generation duration. The Rust reference round-trips the block from its core types; promotion to experimental wants that round-trip as a conformance case.

ext-h3.notes: A geo frame for globe-aware producers: an entity carries its H3 cell, resolution, body and an integer-only transform in the cell's frame (hundredths of the mean edge length, hundredths of a degree, log2 fixed-point scale) beside the core transform the producer derives from them; the environment carries the package's origin cell. The one invariant: the H3 fields are authoritative, the core transform is derived, a reader that knows both prefers the H3 fields. Proposed with the page, the schema, a conformance world with outcome assertions, and two references (Rust, JS) running the same derivation; it becomes experimental when a second implementer signs off, and leaves experimental when a producer outside this repository ships a package using it.
